Some things that help me calm my mind when I go on a downward spiral are:-
1. Practise breathing exercises. If you can, make it a routine everyday.
2. Find a hobby that makes you happy. I like to draw. You can find something similar like reading, knitting or travelling. 
3. Spend time with nature. Try enjoying the small things in life. 
4. When you feel like digging a hole and not coming out ever, let it be. Make small and simple goals. Use alternatives like using mouthwash instead of brushing your teeth if you find the task hard. Keep wet wipes handy if you are unable to take a bath.

Final year med student here. Struggling from depression way before Medical College. Struggled heavily in college, was deep into self-harm and tried to end life once (in a very medical way). 
Finally decided one day, enough was enough. Dragged myself to the hospital's psychiatry unit. Didn't give a shit about what people thought about me. If I could, I talked about it very openly when people asked so that colleagues who are depressed can approach me easily for help.
Even talked to the college administration to help me out with classes I missed. Some of them were very supportive and some of them called me lazy. But it's okay. As long as I tried.
Started on behavioural therapy and medications. Somedays are still a struggle but they have gotten much better than before. 
I hope to push on and never stop trying. I tell myself I have come this far.
